- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

- **Title**: gh-918 Rework legs cannot fix CRAP/method_size/format violations — no dart toolchain in the leg env

## PR Description

Closes #918
### Root Cause

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target like CI: argument/`DART_VERSION` env → the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` in the repo's own quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") → `stable`; downloads from the same dart-archive CDN; installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`; puts `bin` on PATH for the leg session + exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`; version-aware reinstall on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: `dart` wired into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path.
- Docs: `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` (corrected the false "dart from the runner image" claim, `DART_VERSION` var row), `README.md`, `scripts/warmup-session.md`. Dart-repo runners opt in via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]`.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 hermetic tests — resolution precedence, dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, banner parsing, `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. RED first (12 failing pre-fix), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live on the runner: `setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5; second run = version-aware cache hit; `setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

Key finding: the 6 real inline review threads (PRRT_...) are GONE from the open list — they were resolved (my replies + fixes landed, reviewer/automation resolved them). The 4 remaining "open threads" all have `no-id`:
1. "## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES" — the old automated review summary (head 9b538495 = the ORIGINAL rework base, BEFORE my fixes)
2. review-verdict machine notice (head 9b538495, 12:02 — old)
3. rework-consume machine notice (head 9b538495, 12:02 — old)
4. rework-consume machine notice (head 92a1362a, 12:16 — mid-leg)

These are all `no-id` = general PR comments, not inline threads; 3 of them are machine notices explicitly marked "never reply targets" / "do not edit or reply". The first (Automated Code Review) is the stale REQUEST_CHANGES summary from the OLD head — it's a general comment, can't be replied to as a thread (no threadId), and its findings were all fixed.

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks the MANAGED
# install first, then PATH — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin
# dir is registered on PATH, and a foreign PATH dart (not the one this script
# installs) must never satisfy the cache-hit branch: that branch registers
# ${SDK_BIN} on PATH and points DART_HOME at it, which would be a lie for a
# dart the script doesn't own.
# The banner token is captured IN FULL (`[^ )]*`) — beta/dev banners carry
# pre-release suffixes (Dart SDK version: 3.14.0-315.1.beta (beta) ...), and
# truncating at the first "-" makes the version-aware cache check below see a
# permanent mismatch (SDK wiped and re-downloaded on every leg).
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([^ )]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

### Root Cause

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target like CI: argument/`DART_VERSION` env → the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` in the repo's own quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") → `stable`; downloads from the same dart-archive CDN; installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`; puts `bin` on PATH for the leg session + exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`; version-aware reinstall on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).

- Docs: `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` (corrected the false "dart from the runner image" claim, `DART_VERSION` var row), `README.md`, `scripts/warmup-session.md`. Dart-repo runners opt in via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]`.

- Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

installed_version() {

  if [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([^ )]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1

blocks.text:
- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

installed_version() {

  if [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then

  elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. - Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

+hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
+run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
+quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

+- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
+  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
+  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel

+  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
+  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
+  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
+- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
+  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
+  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
+- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
+  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
+  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version

+  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
+  of re-resolving the channel;
+- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
+  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
+  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

+the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
+`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`

+key and the primary key round-trips.

+`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

+heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
+pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.
+
+Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
+`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks the MANAGED
# install first, then PATH — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin
# dir is registered on PATH, and a foreign PATH dart (not the one this script
# installs) must never satisfy the cache-hit branch: that branch registers
# ${SDK_BIN} on PATH and points DART_HOME at it, which would be a lie for a
# dart the script doesn't own.
# The banner token is captured IN FULL (`[^ )]*`) — beta/dev banners carry
# pre-release suffixes (Dart SDK version: 3.14.0-315.1.beta (beta) ...), and
# truncating at the first "-" makes the version-aware cache check below see a
# permanent mismatch (SDK wiped and re-downloaded on every leg).
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([^ )]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. - Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

## PR Description

Closes #918
### Root Cause

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target like CI: argument/`DART_VERSION` env → the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` in the repo's own quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") → `stable`; downloads from the same dart-archive CDN; installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`; puts `bin` on PATH for the leg session + exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`; version-aware reinstall on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: `dart` wired into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path.
- Docs: `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` (corrected the false "dart from the runner image" claim, `DART_VERSION` var row), `README.md`, `scripts/warmup-session.md`. Dart-repo runners opt in via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]`.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 hermetic tests — resolution precedence, dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, banner parsing, `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. RED first (12 failing pre-fix), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live on the runner: `setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5; second run = version-aware cache hit; `setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

# ── Version probes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Installed version from the `dart --version` banner. Checks the MANAGED
# install first, then PATH — a cache-restored SDK is real even before its bin
# dir is registered on PATH, and a foreign PATH dart (not the one this script
# installs) must never satisfy the cache-hit branch: that branch registers
# ${SDK_BIN} on PATH and points DART_HOME at it, which would be a lie for a
# dart the script doesn't own.
# The banner token is captured IN FULL (`[^ )]*`) — beta/dev banners carry
# pre-release suffixes (Dart SDK version: 3.14.0-315.1.beta (beta) ...), and
# truncating at the first "-" makes the version-aware cache check below see a
# permanent mismatch (SDK wiped and re-downloaded on every leg).
installed_version() {
  local d=""
  if [ -x "${SDK_BIN}/dart" ]; then
    d="${SDK_BIN}/dart"
  elif command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    d="$(command -v dart)"
  fi
  [ -n "${d}" ] || { echo ""; return 0; }
  "${d}" --version 2>&1 \
    | sed -n 's/^Dart SDK version: \([^ )]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1
}

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

blocks.text:
- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

- Docs: `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` (corrected the false "dart from the runner image" claim, `DART_VERSION` var row), `README.md`, `scripts/warmup-session.md`. Dart-repo runners opt in via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]`.

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

## PR Description

Closes #918
### Root Cause

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target like CI: argument/`DART_VERSION` env → the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` in the repo's own quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") → `stable`; downloads from the same dart-archive CDN; installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`; puts `bin` on PATH for the leg session + exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`; version-aware reinstall on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: `dart` wired into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path.
- Docs: `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` (corrected the false "dart from the runner image" claim, `DART_VERSION` var row), `README.md`, `scripts/warmup-session.md`. Dart-repo runners opt in via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]`.

### Test Coverage

- `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js` (new, in `run_all.json`): 13 hermetic tests — resolution precedence, dart-archive URL/os-arch mapping, `dart-sdk/bin` PATH layout, banner parsing, `install.sh`/`cache.sh` wiring contracts. RED first (12 failing pre-fix), GREEN after.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2843 passed, 0 failed.
- Live on the runner: `setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5; second run = version-aware cache hit; `setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: gh-918's ask (cached, channel-aware Dart SDK for factory legs) is implemented in the right layer with good tests (13/13 new tests pass; full suite verified green locally: 2845 passed / 0 failed), but the headline "version-aware cache hit" is broken for beta/dev channels — the banner parser truncates `3.14.0-315.1.beta` to `3.14.0`, so the SDK is wiped and re-downloaded on every leg — plus one cache-key wiring inconsistency.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 BLOCKING: `installed_version` vs `channel_latest` version mismatch → cache hit never fires on beta/dev, truncated `DART_VERSION` exported (`setup/dart.sh:69`)
- ⚠️ IMPORTANT: `DART_CACHE_KEY` keys on env/`stable`, not the quality.yml-resolved target; save/restore primary keys can't round-trip (`setup/cache.sh:167`)
- 💡 Suggestions: sha256 verify + retry/timeout on the ~215MB fetch; mistyped arg → bogus version 404; setup-dart detection misses quoted `uses:`/comments; `install.sh all` now installs dart on non-Dart warmups

**Next Steps**:
1. Fix the version-parse regex to capture the full token (`\([^ )]*\)`) and add a beta-banner stub test (RED today)
2. Align `cache.sh` key derivation with `dart.sh plan` (or document the ordering contract)
3. Optional hardening: checksum verification, download retries, arg validation, detection regex tweaks

- `--repo` / `--dir` — the product repo to clone (with its `agents` submodule) and the
  local directory to clone it into.
- `--branch` — checkout/track this branch instead of the repo's default.
- `--exclude` — space-separated tool names to skip (forwarded to `setup/install.sh all`
  as `-tool1 -tool2 ...`; see `setup/install.sh` for the full tool list: `java maven node
  dmtools maestro copilot codemie cursor codegraph playwright kimi gradle android konan dart`).
  Non-Dart targets should pass `--exclude dart` — `install.sh all` now provisions the Dart
  SDK everywhere (~215 MB download, ~1 GB under `~/.dart-sdk`); `install.sh <tools>` runs
  unaffected.
- `--install-args` — extra raw arguments appended to the `install.sh` invocation.

It does **not** create or touch a `dmtools.env` file and does **not** run the agent
pipeline — secrets are expected to already be exposed as real environment variables by
...
env `DART_VERSION`) provisions the Dart SDK for machine-factory leg sessions —
the same gap the golden-test Flutter toolchain covers for fa legs (gh-918):
hosted runner images ship no `dart`, so a rework leg on a Dart repo could not
run `dart analyze/test/format` or `crap4dart check` and claimed success while
quality-gate violations stayed in place. The installer:

- resolves the target exactly the way the repo's CI does — explicit
  argument/env first, then the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:`
  inputs in the checked-out repo's `.github/workflows/*.yml` ("same channel
  the repo's quality.yml uses"), else `stable`; an unrecognized target
  (`--help`, a typo) fails fast with a usage error instead of resolving as a
  version and dying as a late CDN 404 (a leading `v` is stripped —
  `dart.sh v3.9.4` works);
- downloads the SDK from the same dart-archive CDN `dart-lang/setup-dart`
  uses (with retries/timeouts and a `.sha256` sidecar checksum check), so
  leg-local gate output matches CI gate output;
- installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk` (override `DART_INSTALL_DIR`), registers
  `bin` on PATH for the leg session (and subsequent CI steps), and exports
  `DART_HOME`. `DART_VERSION` stays a pure input pin — the installed version
  is visible via `dart --version`; re-exporting it would make a later bare
  `dart.sh` in the same job pin to the previously installed version instead
  of re-resolving the channel;
- is version-aware: an installed-but-stale SDK is reinstalled on mismatch
  (pool VMs keep a persistent `$HOME` — a presence-only check lets an ancient
  binary shadow the requested toolchain forever).

Cache it with `setup/cache.sh dart` (`DART_CACHE_*`): the key is derived from
the target `dart.sh` actually resolves (explicit `dart:<version>` argument >
`DART_VERSION` env > quality.yml detection > stable), so `cache.sh keys dart`
(restore, pre-install) and `cache.sh save dart` (post-install) derive the same
key and the primary key round-trips.
Network-free inspection: `dart.sh plan` (resolved target/URL/layout) and
`dart.sh status`. Unit-tested in `js/unit-tests/test_dartSetup.js`.

`install.sh all` includes `dart` (pattern-consistent with the other
heavyweight toolchains `android`/`konan`): warmups of non-Dart targets can
pass `--exclude dart` to skip the ~1 GB SDK.

Dart-repo runners wire it via `customParams.setupCommands`:
`["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]` (see `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` §3.3).

## PR Description

Closes #918
### Root Cause

Factory legs (dev/review/rework) on Dart repos run with no Dart SDK — hosted runner images ship no `dart` and the factory setup layer had no Dart provisioner — so a rework leg cannot run `dart analyze`/`dart test`/`dart format`/`crap4dart check` and claims success while CRAP/method_size/format violations stay in place (#408, #413, #414).

### Fix

- `setup/dart.sh` (new): cached, channel-aware Dart SDK provisioner — same pattern as the golden-test Flutter toolchain for fa legs. Resolves the target like CI: argument/`DART_VERSION` env → the `dart-lang/setup-dart` step's `sdk:`/`channel:` in the repo's own quality workflow ("same channel the repo's quality.yml uses") → `stable`; downloads from the same dart-archive CDN; installs under `~/.dart-sdk/dart-sdk`; puts `bin` on PATH for the leg session + exports `DART_HOME`/`DART_VERSION`; version-aware reinstall on mismatch (persistent pool-VM `$HOME`).
- `setup/install.sh` / `setup/cache.sh`: `dart` wired into the tool list, PATH verification, and `DART_CACHE_*` cache key/path.
- Docs: `docs/machine-factory-integration.md` (corrected the false "dart from the runner image" claim, `DART_VERSION` var row), `README.md`, `scripts/warmup-session.md`. Dart-repo runners opt in via `customParams.setupCommands: ["bash agents/setup/dart.sh"]`.

- Live on the runner: `setup/dart.sh` installed stable 3.13.5; second run = version-aware cache hit; `setup/install.sh dart` PATH verification green.

### Notes

- Non-dart repos unaffected; `DART_CACHE_*` keys the CI cache. No workflow/dispatch changes — the fix lands entirely in the setup layer this repo owns.
